---
description: "Use BMad and MCP to author, run, or resume publishing the OrangeHRM login/session regression execution."
agent: "agent"
argument-hint: "author | run | publish [report path]"
---

Follow the approved [plan](../../_bmad-output/plan-orangehrm-regression-automation.md) as the sole scope authority and the [operational protocol](../../README.md). Resolve the user's mode from the prompt arguments; default to `run`. Never change installed BMad files or use direct TestRail/Jira REST or the BMad Jira CLI.

For `author`, invoke the installed [BMad QA skill](../../.agents/skills/bmad-qa-generate-e2e-tests/SKILL.md) exactly as its instructions specify, then follow the rendered workflow. The approved scenarios are valid login, invalid credentials, required fields, logout, and unauthenticated session protection. Use Playwright MCP to inspect visible behavior on the configured demo, with fresh isolated contexts. Never return credentials, cookies, or tokens in browser tool output. Keep the [catalog](../../tests/catalog.json) and [executable scenarios](../../tests/orangehrm.spec.js) aligned by stable ID. No data mutations and no weakening genuine failures. Respect the skill's human checkpoints.

For `run`, execute `npm run test:unit`, `npx playwright test --list`, `npm run test:regression`, and `npm run sync:dry-run`. Continue to dry-run even when regression exits nonzero; preserve genuine failures and report their final status and evidence paths. Do not publish automatically in run mode. A dry-run performs no MCP writes and is not evidence of successful publishing.

For `publish`, use only TestRail MCP and the official Atlassian Rovo MCP. Discover the actual tool schemas, active projects/suites/sections/templates/required case fields/statuses, and Jira cloud/project/issue type/required fields using read tools. Have the human choose destinations. Credentials must be entered only into VS Code's password input or the server's OAuth UI, never chat. If servers, authentication or destinations are unavailable, retain local evidence, report publication pending, and stop without writes. Record verified non-secret discovery and selected destinations in the ignored integration configuration. Validate the actual prepared payload against the discovered schemas; local operation intents are not a substitute for MCP tool schemas.

Before preparing an unfinished report, confirm the runner is no longer active and use `node scripts/sync-results.js --finalize-interrupted --report PATH`. Preserve completed outcomes; unfinished scenarios stay interrupted. Then prepare with `npm run sync:prepare -- --report PATH`. Never finalize a running report. Never generate fake production evidence or synthetic defects.

Process one ready-to-reconcile operation at a time in dependency order. Before ANY new case/run/result/issue write, search the full destination by the operation's exact stable identity, including all pages and archived/completed runs as appropriate. Cases match the stable scenario ID in refs/title in the selected section. Runs match the execution identity in description/name. Jira issues match the execution/scenario marker in description and exact project; inspect candidate issues, not merely JQL fuzzy-match counts. Results match their exact comment marker within the selected run/case; resolve its test ID with `query_test`, then read `get_results`. For cases, also verify the existing preconditions/steps match the catalog before reuse.

Persist a normalized complete reconciliation receipt using `npm run sync:receipt -- RECEIPT_PATH --report PATH`. More than one match or an incomplete identity search requires manual reconciliation; do not retry a write. Zero matches allows a write, including after an ambiguous timeout only when the server can establish complete absence; if eventual consistency or permission limits make absence uncertain, stop for reconciliation. Then checkpoint with `npm run sync:begin -- OPERATION_ID --report PATH` BEFORE invoking the discovered MCP write tool. Use `add_case`, `mutate_run` (create only), `add_results_for_cases` (one result per call), and discovered Rovo issue creation as applicable. Adapt intents to their discovered schemas. Never call a write when local status is confirmed or ambiguous.

Immediately persist the actual returned remote ID/key and validated context as a sanitized write receipt before any next write. On known rejection, persist failed; on timeout/lost response, persist ambiguous. Never invent identifiers or treat a successful local command as a remote receipt. An interrupted submitting operation becomes ambiguous on resume. Create one fresh Jira issue per final failed/timedOut scenario per execution; retry-recovered, skipped or interrupted scenarios never get defects. Record reproduction steps, expected and actual outcomes, and local evidence references in the issue. TestRail failed results must include that confirmed Jira key.

Finish with `npm run sync:check -- --report PATH`. Read back confirmed TestRail cases, run and results, and Jira issues/linkage through MCP. Claim live acceptance only when every selected scenario has a matching case and result with returned identifiers and every final failure has a verified Jira key on its result. Report any remaining pending/ambiguous operations and exit unsuccessfully for incomplete synchronization. Do not upload raw traces/screenshots without a separate human review for sensitive data.
